system.description:
Range and duration as the spell copied. Cast a copy of one Evocation or Conjuration spell of 4th level or lower that you know or have prepared, made of shadow. Damage is halved, and the GM trims any other effect. A creature that makes a Will save sees through it and is unaffected.

Classes: Wizard, Illusionist, Bard
system.range: Range and duration as the spell copied
system.saveEffect: Sees through it and is unaffected
